name: @gosleep/runner-adapter
description: SessionAdapter interface + the Claude Code adapter (v1) — the ONLY place the harness process shells to `claude` or writes provider-specific settings. Four seams: listSessions, installSessionHooks, deliverAnswer, readTranscript. `apps/core/` talks to a provider through SessionAdapter and never through the CLI directly, per GSL-281 (rev-3 addendum Delta 10). The `contract.md` sibling sketches an OpenAI/Codex adapter as a v2 reference.
